atoms.content: The next implementation sequence is exact safe-branch staging parity, then actual iPhone/PWA validation, then only observed-gap fixes, regression validation, and finally human approval before production promotion.
atoms.why: This is the smallest high-value missing dimension between current source/CI implementation and trustworthy release readiness.
